svg.title: Folding crate: corner catch
svg.text: Corner catch (one at each top corner of each end wall; left-hand shown, right-hand is the mirror image). mm.
u: along the end wall from its middle toward the corner; n: out from the wall's inner face (the wall is n 0 to 10); h: up from the wall's hinge line.
A LATCHED: section at the tongue (h = 108.1)
engagement 3; keeper 4; 1 to the wall's edge
Housing foot hatched (cut). Tongue light green. Inner face of the wall at n = 0.
B BUTTON PRESSED FLUSH: the cam pulls the tongue 6 mm in
The corner is free once its button is in 3.5 mm: the tongue is then 0.5 mm clear of
the keeper (3 mm engaged at rest). An end wall tips in only while both its corners are free.
With the buttons held, the tongues pass the keepers once the wall has tipped in 7.4°; then the buttons
can be let go. Swung back up, the tongue's chamfer rides over the keeper and it snaps in: the catch clicks.
C SECTION THROUGH THE BUTTON (u = 100), at rest
Housing printed as two halves split at n = 5 (the wall's mid-plane),
clamped onto the wall's notched top edge by 2 M3 screws. n → out of the crate.
F = 1.278 N/mm x (2.15 mm preload + press). Lee Spring LC 024C 08M:
7.30 lb/in, free 20.65 mm, OD 6.1 mm; fitted 18.5 mm at rest,
